answer: Make each agent prove work by solving verification tasks, and record the statistical fingerprint of its mistakes. One operator piloting many clones cannot help but mirror the same error distribution across all of them, so their patterns cluster into one narrow canyon of behavior; the ledger measures the distance between error profiles and merges any that fall inside that band into a single voice. Genuinely independent agents scatter their errors across a wide horizon, keeping full weight, so flooding with fakes buys nothing.
